name: Mataró (Spain)
description: Navy blue field with a red cross throughout, its arms one fifth of the height, the historic ensign of the maritime province of Mataró.
history: The design corresponds to the registration ensign granted to the maritime province of Mataró by royal order of the Ministry of the Navy of 30 July 1845. On 4 March 1975 the council adopted a parted flag with the four bars, but on 12 September 1985 it resolved to adopt as the flag of the city the historic and traditional flag of the former maritime province: an oblong flag of 2:3, navy blue, with a red cross throughout of arms 1/5 of the height.

features.role: cross throughout with arms 1/5 of the height
